headline: Fronts Flare Across Six Sectors as Bases Shift
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the map has reshuffled its hottest theatres. Stlican Shelf, still the busiest sector, has risen from a two‑hour lull to five ownership flips in the latest two hours and forty‑seven for the day, while its casualty rate steadies at roughly 170 colonial and 130 warden losses per hour. Weathered Expanse has surged, recording nine flips in the past two hours and twenty‑seven overall, with casualties climbing to 620 colonial and 746 warden per hour and enlistments accelerating to 33 per hour. Deadlands remains volatile, adding five flips in the last two hours and twenty for the day, its casualty stream now at 288 colonial and 368 warden per hour. Godcrofts, quiet in the previous window, erupted with seven flips in the last two hours and thirteen daily, casualties accelerating to 87 colonial and 35 warden per hour. Linn Mercy continues its heavy grind, logging five recent flips and nine daily, with casualties soaring to 675 colonial and 416 warden per hour and enlistments jumping to 94 per hour. Callahans Passage and Fishermans Row each retain about a half‑dozen daily turnovers but show no fresh two‑hour activity; Callahans’ enlistments have spiked to 94 per hour while its casualties climb past 450 per hour for both sides. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held southern fringe remain static with no base changes.
